versions.content: Express Decisions when Deriving Objects Applying Vari- ationPoint is a suitable way to express intended decisions to be made when deriving objects from blueprints. In this case the value of the UML tag vh.latestBindingTime is blueprintDerivationTime and VariationPoint . blueprintCondition , VariationPoint . formalBlueprintGenerator respec- tively AttributeValueVariationPoint . blueprintValue shall be used to ex- press the intended derivation.
